description:
Since at least 2026-10-09 the working tree carries uncommitted changes (`git diff lib/defk.ex lib/defk/build.ex`, 36 lines) that look like a timing experiment:
- `__before_compile__` prints "DEFKTIMING <module> compile=.. build=.. prep=.." to stderr at every compile.
- `Defk.Build.build!` prints "DEFKBUILD <module> hash=.. hit=.." and "cc_start/cc_dur" lines.
- `__defk_load__` prints "DEFKLOAD <module> start=.. dur=.. us" to stderr on every NIF load, i.e. at runtime, in releases too.
- A `DEFK_EXP` environment variable: `o0` compiles at -O0 (and is correctly part of the cache hash via the flags), `nobuild` skips cc and makes `__defk_load__` catch a throw and return :ok without loading the NIF, so every kernel then raises :defk_not_loaded.

`mix format --check-formatted`, `mix credo --strict` and `mix test` all pass with these changes, so the `mix ci` gate would not stop them landing. `bw prime` warns about the dirty tree.

This is the owner's call, which is why the ticket is ready-for-human: keep the measurement as a proper feature or drop it.
- Drop: `git checkout lib/defk.ex lib/defk/build.ex`. Record any numbers the experiment produced in a comment here or on the ticket they were for (likely the compile-time cost question behind defk-9if or defk-6ag).
- Keep: move it behind `config :defk, build_timing: true` (compile_env, dev/test only like `mode: :elixir`), never print at NIF load time, drop the `nobuild` path (a kernel that silently does not load violates the runtime contract), and add a test that nothing is written to stderr by default.

Done when: the working tree is clean on main and, if kept, the feature is behind config with a test.

comments.text: ready-for-human: the diff is the owner's uncommitted experiment; an agent should not revert it unasked. Once the decision is recorded here it becomes ready-for-agent.

Checked 2026-10-13: the experiment is gone. The working tree on main is clean, lib/ has no DEFK_EXP, DEFKTIMING, DEFKBUILD or DEFKLOAD, and no commit ever added them (git log -S'DEFKTIMING' --all is empty), so the uncommitted diff was dropped. Done-when (clean tree on main) holds via the drop path; no numbers were recorded with it.

title: Resolve the uncommitted DEFK_EXP compile-timing instrumentation in lib/defk.ex and lib/defk/build.ex
